newsitem.title: LEBANON: Bank of Lebanon issues CDs worth one bln pounds.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Lebanon issues CDs worth one bln pounds.

text.p: The Bank of Lebanon issued on Thursday certificates of deposit dated January 10 to commercial banks worth one billion Lebanese pounds.
All the CDs sold were 45-day certificates at 12.25-percent annual interest. There were no sales of 60-day CDs at 13 percent.
Last week, the Bank sold 45-day CDs worth one billion pounds at 12.25 percent and 60-day CDs worth four billion pounds at 13 percent.
